fact: Rwanda's national UPR report of 12 November 2025 says revision of the Access to Information Law is underway, and that since 2021 twenty-two awareness campaigns on Law No. 04/2013 reached 3,040 people.
title: National report submitted pursuant to Human Rights Council resolutions 5/1 and 16/21: Rwanda
publisher: United Nations Human Rights Council (Government of Rwanda)
